{{Top|leg}}
The '''976a lubricant container''' was a model of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[lubricant container]]. They could be pressed into service as [[Blaster gas/Legends|blaster gas]] canisters if washed out with [[Berko-8]] and fitted with a different nozzle to allow connection with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] gas chamber.
